title: [finding] After #4377 three key pairs in the designer i18n table hold byte-identical values, and `engine.form.select` has no consumer at all
body:
Found while executing #4377 on branch `claude/issue-4377-designer-table-ellipsis`. Observation-class: nothing a user hits, because every rendered string is correct either way. Recording it so the next reader of `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` does not have to re-derive why the table names the same value twice.

## What #4377 made visible

#4377 moved five keys from ASCII `...` to U+2026 `…`. Three of those five had a sibling key that already carried `…`, so the pairs are now byte-identical in both the `en` and the `zh` block:

| key | sibling | value after #4377 (en / zh) |
|---|---|---|
| `engine.form.select` | `engine.form.selectEllipsis` | `Select…` / `请选择…` |
| `engine.form.selectObjectDots` | `engine.form.selectObject` | `Select object…` / `选择对象…` |
| `engine.form.selectFieldDots` | `engine.form.selectField` | `Select field…` / `选择字段…` |

The `Dots` suffix was the naming: `selectObjectDots` was the spelling *with* trailing dots, `selectObject` the one without. Both now end in an ellipsis, so the suffix no longer names a difference — it reads as a distinction that has quietly stopped existing.

This is a consequence of the convergence, not a regression it introduced: before #4377 the pairs differed only in which ellipsis glyph they used, which was the defect. Collapsing them is the follow-on question the convergence raises.

## `engine.form.select` is dead

Beyond the duplication, one of the three has no consumer anywhere in the repo:

```
$ git grep -n "'engine.form.select'"
packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts:894:  'engine.form.select': 'Select…',
packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts:2668:  'engine.form.select': '请选择…',
```

Only the two definitions; no `t('engine.form.select', …)` call site. Its sibling `engine.form.selectEllipsis` is the live one, read at four sites (`SchemaForm.tsx:1209`, `SchemaForm.tsx:1237`, `widgets.tsx:1028`, `widgets.tsx:1231`). The other two pairs are both live: `selectObject` at `widgets.tsx:184` and `selectObjectDots` at `widgets.tsx:396`; `selectField` at `widgets.tsx:960` and `selectFieldDots` at `widgets.tsx:527`.

## Dispositions, if someone takes this

- **`engine.form.select`** — delete both entries. Unreferenced, and now a byte-identical twin of a key that is referenced. Lowest risk of the three.
- **The two live pairs** — either collapse each pair onto one key and move the two `widgets.tsx` call sites, or leave them and rename the `Dots` keys to say what actually distinguishes them (if anything still does; from the call sites they look like the same placeholder reached by two paths). Collapsing is the smaller table; renaming is the smaller diff.

Deliberately not doing any of this inside #4377: that card is ten one-character edits plus a header note, and touching key identity would put its two `widgets.tsx` consumers in scope, which the dispatch carved out for the in-flight #4373.

## Anchor

Verified on `origin/main` at `079f15571` plus the #4377 branch. Related: #4377 (the convergence that surfaced it), #3878 / objectstack#6015 (the ellipsis ruling).
